basics.name: Guanjie Huang
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Artificial Intelligence
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at HKUST(GZ) researching efficient and reliable multimodal intelligence, with a focus on audio-visual learning, cued speech recognition, multimodal large language models and agents, uncertainty estimation, and audio deepfake detection.

work.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
work.summary: Research on audio-visual intelligence, multimodal large language models, model reliability, and assistive speech technologies.
highlights: Developed few-shot audio-visual learning methods using semantic prompts, adapters, latent attention, and prototype regularization.
Built training-free and semi-training-free cued speech recognition systems with multimodal agents and MLLM-driven hand modeling.
Studied audio deepfake detection, physically grounded audio-visual generation benchmarks, and evidential uncertainty for in-context learning.

work.name: Suzhou INSNEX Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
work.summary: Developed industrial visual inspection algorithms for defect synthesis and detection.
highlights: Designed GAN-based defect generation methods for low-data industrial inspection.
Built generation, detection, and multi-task training pipelines.

work.name: Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data
work.summary: Worked on large-scale multimodal UAV tracking datasets and learning-assisted optimization.
highlights: Co-developed WebUAV-3M with 3.3 million frames from 4,500 videos across 223 categories.
Developed semi-automatic annotation, evaluation, testing, and visualization tools.

work.name: Australian National University
work.summary: Researched unified image style transfer methods.

work.name: CSIRO
work.summary: Developed interactive 3D geological visualization tools with PyVista and reproducible Binder environments.
